name: The Queen's Head

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Queen's Head stands on Station Road, which leads down to the River Nene and the site of the old railway station.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The Nene Valley was once busy with railways as well as river traffic.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:By the river path, a fisherman found a Danish belt buckle. On it are numbers.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The buckle numbers]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Whose buckle is it? (name)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:21 12 6 spells ULF. The buckle belongs to Ulf the guard.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Ulf's buckle was found on the river path.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: the Queen's Head is the village's other pub.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 320 metres as the crow flies, to the Black Horse. Follow Station Road back down to the crossroads. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
